thread:
maria: FYI — atlas-west2 p99 TTFT jumped from ~120ms -> ~420ms around 06:12. tokens/sec on shard-07 flattened, host-nj-07 CPU pegged. looks like shard placement imbalance after last rollout.
ajay: can you drop the grafana link and the panel/query?
maria: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/token-slo?orgId=1&var-region=atlas-west2
query snippet:```
rate(tokens_processed_total{shard="shard-07"}[1m])
```
sana: alerts: token_slo_p99_high@06:12 and shard_rebalance_failed@06:15 :warning:
deploy-bot: rollout completed for model-3 at 06:05 on atlas-west2 (canary 10%).
lucas: my guess is kvcache hot-shard + non-uniform pod packing. any kvcache evict/rebalance logs?
maria: saw this in the logs:```
ERROR kvcache: shard 07 failed rebalance: mismatch assigned_slots
```
also `dmesg` from host-nj-07 shows repeated net rx drops.
ajay: quick mitigation options: 1) manual reschedule shard-07 to another rack 2) temporarily scale H100 pool in west2 3) enable fallback to smaller model variant for bursty routes
sana: I can start a manual reschedule now. will cordon host-nj-07 and force evict pods for shard-07. expect a short tail spike during eviction.
maria: runbook command: `tools/ops reschedule-shard --shard shard-07 --region atlas-west2`
sre-bot: Alert acknowledged by @sana. Current snapshot — p99: 438ms, p95: 210ms, p50: 85ms. tokens/sec(shard-07): 12.4 (cluster median 78.1).
lucas: opened infra ticket INF-3141 to adjust autoscaler bucketing; avoid single-host spikes by shard-aware balancing.
sana: reschedule started (evict initiated). will post updates.
maria: monitoring — if p99 doesn't fall below 200ms in 10m we will scale H100 and optionally shift canary traffic.
sana: reschedule completed at 06:28. immediate improvement: p99 -> 162ms, tokens/sec(shard-07) -> 73.6. cordon cleared.
maria: good recovery :thumbsup: will kick off a brief postmortem and propose a kvcache rebalance fix + autoscaler tweak.
